title: Solar + storage doesn’t automatically mean backup: Mapping what actually stays powered

title: What 11 islands reveal about the real bottleneck in renewable mini-grids
content: An IEA-PVPS report examining 11 islands finds that achieving nearly 100% renewable electricity depends as much on strong leadership, community engagement, financing and early planning as on technology. While proven technical solutions vary widely, successful transitions require tailored grid design and sustained institutional support, making replication especially challenging for smaller, remote and lower-income islands.
